# s398 — Findings carry a kind (fix, owner, later); owner questions are structured; only a real FAIL writes Review FAIL

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

In ork's run, 23 of 28 relays needed a fix round, and owner design calls were mixed into fix rounds or buried in "later notes" that only the outer session read (S65's spent-grant behaviour, S84's four UI suggestions). One run got the note "Review FAIL: none (no blockers)" because a fix round ran for UI edits, although the gate passed (S65). ork decided adj 163 (`review.finding-kinds`) and built it (ork S120, S137):
- every reviewer, UI pass and gate finding is `fix` (goes to the fix round), `owner` (a design call: 2 to 4 options and a recommendation; does not block the gate unless marked `blocker`) or `later` (a follow-up item with a one-line title);
- a `Review FAIL` note is written only for `VERDICT: FAIL`.
ork also answers structured questions by digit (ork adj 168 `ui.structured-questions`, S111). The v8 run report has a free-text `owner needed: LIST`, so each consumer parses it differently; s396 (relay-run ask) needs the same shape.
